INSERT INTO GOLF_RENTAL_FAIL_LOG ( RCP_INF_SEQ, RCP_SEQ, ORDER_NO, TYPE, ORDER_STAT_CD, MESSAGE, REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{rcpInfSeq}, #{rcpSeq}, #{orderNo}, #{type}, #{orderStatCd}, #{message}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}, TYPE = #{type}, ORDER_STAT_CD = #{orderStatCd}, MESSAGE = #{message}, REG_DTTM = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE GOLF_RENTAL_FAIL_LOG SET MESSAGE = 'SUCCESS', REG_DTTM = NOW() WHERE RCP_INF_SEQ = #{rcpInfSeq} AND RCP_SEQ = #{rcpSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT A.RCP_INF_SEQ, A.RCP_SEQ, A.RCP_INF_STAT, A.CAN_REASON, A.RCP_NUMBER, A.SR_TYPE, A.RT_NUMBER, A.PAY_TYPE, A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ, A.CUS_SEND_NM, A.CUS_SEND_TELNUM, A.CUS_SEND_TELNUM2, A.CUS_SEND_ZIP, A.CUS_SEND_ADDR1, A.CUS_SEND_ADDR2, A.SEND_ISL_YN, A.BR_STR_NM, A.BR_STR_CODE, A.CUS_RE_NM, A.CUS_RE_TELNUM, A.CUS_RE_TELNUM2, A.CUS_RE_ZIP, A.CUS_RE_ADDR1, A.CUS_RE_ADDR2, A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ, A.RECV_ISL_YN, A.BR_END_NM, A.BR_END_CODE, A.PD_NM, A.PD_PACK, A.PD_GOLF_CNT, A.PD_INDIV_PRICE, A.BOSTON_CNT, A.PD_CNT, A.PD_ETC_PAY, A.PD_DOSUN_PAY, A.PD_DELI_PAY, A.PD_PAY, A.PD_MEMO, A.PIC_REQ_DT, A.SC_TIME, A.EXT_COMP, A.EXT_COMP_TELNUM, A.PD_BARCODE, A.PD_REC_DT, A.REG_DATE, A.MOD_DATE, A.REG_USER, A.USE_YN, A.RCP_KIND, A.CUS_RECEIPT_NM, A.CUS_RECEIPT_TELNUM, A.KPAY_TID, A.USER_ID, A.ICON_FEE, A.CHANGE_DELTYPE_YN, A.BOX_CNT, A.BOX_SIZE, A.RCP_TYPE, A.RCP_AIR_SEQ, B.ORDER_NO, B.TYPE, B.ORDER_STAT_CD, B.MESSAGE, B.REG_DTTM FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_INF A INNER JOIN GOLF_RENTAL_FAIL_LOG B ON A.RCP_INF_SEQ = B.RCP_INF_SEQ AND A.RCP_SEQ = B.RCP_SEQ WHERE B.MESSAGE != 'SUCCESS';
